title: Exactness of sheafification on Proj
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ with its standard grading, and $P=\mathbf P^1_k$ as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. If $0\to M'\to M\to M''\to0$ is an exact sequence of graded $S$-modules with degree-preserving maps, then the associated sequence of $\mathcal O_P$-modules [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] (1) $0\to\widetilde{M'}\to\widetilde M\to\widetilde{M''}\to0$ is exact.
